first_impression: A landing screen identifies Agent WebMCP and offers a Continue to demo button. The demo opens to a dense Fleet Cockpit showing server, service, operation, activity, agent, and job controls.
after_state: The operational cockpit loaded with project-novus health (19 healthy, 1 degraded), 27 services, and a failed job visible. Service rows expose Inspect controls.
notes: No authentication was required; the main console visibly supports health inspection and service/job operations.

first_impression: Oasy presents a polished marketing page for an agentic-web advertising/publisher stack, with Analyze, Monetize, Block, and Enhance sections. A prominent free domain-readiness scanner is the clearest interactive workflow.
action_attempted: Entered example.com in the domain scanner and clicked Scan your domain.
after_state: A scan-complete report appeared for example.com with a 0/100 agent-readiness score, crawler policy findings, and detailed checks for robots.txt, TDM, noai, payment challenge, MCP, A2A, sitemap, and structured content.
notes: The scanner worked without signup and produced concrete per-check results.

first_impression: A minimal AgentBridge landing page says it makes websites ready for AI agents and shows one primary CTA. The purpose is identifiable, but the page exposes little detail before interaction.
after_state: The page remained visually and interactively unchanged after the click; no setup flow, tool inspector, or confirmation appeared.
notes: Reachable, but the only demonstrated CTA appeared inert in this browser session.

first_impression: AgentCart is an AI-native shopping marketplace with catalog navigation, product comparison, cart access, and a natural-language Shop together with an agent panel. Products and Add to cart buttons are immediately visible.
action_attempted: Clicked Add to cart for Nova Pro 14.
after_state: The page stayed on the marketplace and the accessibility snapshot showed no visible cart-count or confirmation change. The cart button and product controls remained available.
notes: The central shopping workflow is clearly presented, but this add-to-cart attempt gave no observable feedback.

first_impression: AgentGate is a simple human-approval queue for proposed AI-agent actions. It displays Pending review (0), an action-type selector, a proposal textbox, and a Propose button, while noting WebMCP is not detected in this browser.
action_attempted: Entered Archive a test item and clicked Propose.
after_state: Pending review changed from 0 to 1 and the new item exposed Optional note, Approve, and Reject controls. The proposal form remained available for additional actions.
notes: The approval-gate flow worked locally without login; browser WebMCP detection warning was visible.

first_impression: Agentic Sandbox opens as a factory decision lab with a mission brief, active human packaging-line override, scenario comparison table, and replay/copy controls. Baseline and two deterministic scenarios show output, cost, defects, and machine constraints.
after_state: The comparison table remained unchanged with Scenario A passing output/defect/machine constraints but failing cost, while Scenario B passed cost/defect/machine but failed output. No visible run receipt or state transition appeared.
notes: The lock-bound comparison and evidence values were clearly visible; the run action produced no observable change in this session.
